purpose: Git-tracked stability-aware R_TES profile with nested detector-state nuisance refits while the 2024-12-06 order-2 effective readout shape and 2024-12-05 white floor remain fixed

R_TES_profile.interpretation: outer fixed profile only; R_TES is never a simultaneous continuous optimizer coordinate
R_TES_profile.stability_semantics: an unstable inherited nuisance state at fixed R does not reject the R point; nuisance optimization searches for stable candidates and only no stable fitted candidate marks the point unresolved

guardrail: R_TES is profiled because no independently linked 2024-12-05 IV operating point is available. Fixed-R points are not rejected merely because the inherited nuisance state is unstable; the nuisance optimizer must search for stable candidates. A good profile point shows only that an R_TES operating-point shift can mimic the day-specific low/mid shape under the tested nuisance model. A poor profile does not exclude other untested detector-state differences. No result identifies physical electronics drift.
